value.rationale: The radial shell of Fock monomials has fixed physical width and yields a natural threshold when angular rotation velocity beta gamma r^(gamma-1) passes through order one. The critical case produces a nontrivial exact circle heat semigroup, not mere averaging; all essential spectra, norms and indices are classified for every continuous angular profile. This describes a physically motivated localization family with a sharp compactness boundary, not an isolated arbitrary invariant. It makes no claim about full spectral data or discontinuous profiles.
